verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents a public API under its docs/endpoints section. It authenticates with API keys passed as Bearer tokens, and those keys are generated in the platform dashboard. A built-in MCP server also lets AI clients drive the platform programmatically. The probe found no OpenAPI spec at the common paths, and the docs only show the auth overview rather than which endpoints exist. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, evidence of endpoint coverage (flows, runs, tables), clarity on whether API keys need the platform/admin tier, and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
